summary: Reviewed 50 units. Issues: errors 11, minor 22. Main points: (1) u33 drafter text_flag on parā.uktā is unsound: it is the edition's regular spelling of the term parā-ukta (3.1), so the term is kept and the flag should be deleted; u33 also aligned to the 3.13 untranslated daśa-/pañca-bandha and to the Book 3 'Such is X' closing-label convention; (2) u4 wrong case label for mūlya-kṛtā (not instrumental); (3) u5 saṃnidhāna-sannā translated though to be kept untranslated; (4) u26 invented sense 'of the lower half' for avara-ardhya; (5) u38 -rātra compound labelled feminine; (6) Hindi slips: प्रेत (u43), भी/वैसा (u37), added सत्य (u38), dropped और/क्योंकि (u32, u48), तो (u42); (7) confidence of u6 and u7 lowered to low. Companion patches of one issue are listed as consecutive issues and should be applied together, in order. No regrouping suggested (units follow the edition's verse numbers; u29 continues the pratiṣiddhāḥ list of u28 but is a separate numbered verse).
